verdicts.explanation: Section 3.4 states that the authors' own Na3.36Zr1.92Cu0.08Si2.2P0.8O12 gave 9.62×10⁻⁴ S/cm, and Section 2.3 gives room-temperature EIS, so a null numeric temperature is correct. The 1200 °C / 12 h sintering and solid-state method are stated in Section 2.2 for the synthesized materials.
The paper states that the authors' Nd-doped Na3.1Zr1.9Nd0.1Si2PO12 gave 5.48×10⁻⁴ S/cm, with room-temperature EIS (Section 2.3) and the general Section 2.2 synthesis conditions.
The paper states that the authors' Fe-doped Na3.2Zr1.8Fe0.2Si2PO12 gave 1.68×10⁻⁴ S/cm, with room-temperature EIS and the Section 2.2 synthesis conditions.

The paper reports the Co-doped Na3.3Zr1.95Co0.05Si2.2P0.8O12 value of ~2.63×10⁻³ S/cm with the citation [6], so literature_cited is correct. No temperature or secondary synthesis values are attached to this value in the paper, so nulls are correct.

The paper gives 3.38×10⁻⁴ S/cm as the reported value for Cu-doped NASICON from [49], a literature comparison value. The record correctly notes that the composition is not given, and no temperature or secondary fields are stated.
The paper gives 4.21×10⁻⁷ S/cm as the previously reported value for Nd-doped NASICON from [50], a literature comparison value with no composition, temperature or synthesis details given.
The paper gives 1×10⁻⁷ S/cm as the previously reported value for Fe-doped NASICON from [51], a literature comparison value with no composition, temperature or synthesis details given.
